c.tagline: Norway's fjord capital, where UNESCO wharves meet mountain funiculars.

taxi.fareNote: Taxis are pricey and metered with higher night and weekend tariffs. Uber does not operate in Bergen, but Bolt is available; otherwise book by app, phone, or at ranks, as street-hailing is uncommon.

emergency.note: 112 reaches police, 113 ambulance, and 110 fire; 112 also works as the general EU-style emergency number.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

hood_desc: The UNESCO-listed old Hanseatic wharf of leaning wooden merchant houses along the Vagen harbor; the historic heart best for first-timers who want landmarks, the fish market, and the Floibanen funicular all on foot.

The compact downtown core around Torgallmenningen, Ole Bulls plass, and Lille Lungegardsvann lake, packed with shops, restaurants, theaters, and hotels; the convenient central base for staying in the middle of everything.
A quiet residential peninsula of narrow lanes and white wooden houses reaching out to the aquarium and Nordnes park; calm and scenic, good for travelers who want seaside strolls and local atmosphere.

A historic district of preserved 18th-century wooden houses climbing the hillside north of the center along the fjord; peaceful and photogenic, suited to those wanting a residential, local feel near the water.
The university and student quarter around Nygardshoyden and the museum gardens, with cafes, bars, and cultural venues; an artsy, lively area popular with younger travelers and creatives.

water.note: Tap water is excellent and safe everywhere.

transit.hours: Bybanen light rail and most bus lines run roughly 5:30 AM to past midnight, with reduced night services on weekends.
transit.note: Skyss operates the integrated network of the Bybanen light rail and city buses; a single ticket covers transfers within the zone for a set time.
transit.pay: Buy tickets in the Skyss app, at machines, or on board (surcharge for cash on board). Tap or show your ticket; single tickets are time-limited and allow transfers.

bus: Vy and Nor-way intercity coaches to Oslo, Stavanger, and beyond

car.idp: Not required for EU/EEA and US licenses

ferry: Fjord Line ferry to Hirtshals, Denmark
Norled and express boats to Sognefjord and Nordfjord villages
train: Bergen Line (Bergensbanen) to Oslo via Voss and Myrdal

transit.m: Bybanen Light Rail line 1 to city center (~45 min, every 5-10 min)
Flybussen airport coach to city center (~30 min)

tip.r: Service is included in prices; rounding up or leaving 5-10% for good service at restaurants is appreciated but not expected.
